extracted.intended_audience: users of PARI/GP (mathematicians and developers) working with elliptic curves and related number-theory computations
extracted.subtask_description: Library/manual documentation for PARI/GP elliptic-curve functions, giving input requirements, expected outputs, algorithmic complexity, and usage notes for many ell-* functions (ellinit, ellgroup, ellcard, etc.). Intended to guide correct invocation and interpretation of results.

rubrics_metrics.name: ellap: algorithm selection & complexity
rubrics_metrics.description: Computation of trace/ap (Frobenius trace) for elliptic curve E over finite field F_q; algorithm chosen depends on CM and field size/characteristic.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If E/F_q has CM by a principal imaginary quadratic order use an O((log q)^2) explicit formula (Kronecker symbols, Cornacchia). Otherwise use Shanks–Mestre baby-step/giant-step (~O(q^{1/4}) time and storage) up to about 30-digit q; beyond that use SEA (heuristic ~O((log q)^4)), making primes up to ~200 digits feasible. In small characteristic use Mestre (p=2), Kohel (p=3,5,7,13), Satoh-Harley (~O(p^2 n^2)) or Kedlaya (~O(p n^3)). Library syntax: ellap(GEN E, GEN p = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellcard: input requirements and behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute order of group E(F_q) for ell structure E; if E is over Q, p must be provided and result is cardinality of reduction over F_p.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For curves over finite fields omit p. For curves over Q, supply prime p; equation need not be minimal at p (but minimal model is more efficient). Singular reduction is allowed: function returns order of group of non-singular points. Availability of seadata package speeds computation for large-characteristic finite fields. Syntax: ellcard(GEN E, GEN p = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellchangecurve: coordinate-change semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: Change coordinates of elliptic curve E using vector v = [u,r,s,t] applying x = u^2 x' + r, y = u^3 y' + s u^2 x' + t (v=1 denotes [1,0,0,0]).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E must be an ell structure (output of ellinit). Syntax: ellchangecurve(GEN E, GEN v).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellchangepoint / ellchangepointinv: point coordinate transforms
rubrics_metrics.description: Change coordinates of a point (or vector of points) using v = [u,r,s,t] consistent with ellchangecurve; ellchangepointinv applies inverse transformation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Handles vectors of points; can invert transformation using ellchangepointinv. Syntax: ellchangepoint(GEN x, GEN v) and ellchangepointinv(GEN x, GEN ch). Examples show round-trip behaviour.

rubrics_metrics.name: ellconvertname: conversion between Cremona name and triplet
rubrics_metrics.description: Convert elliptic-curve Cremona string name (e.g., "123b1") to triplet [conductor, isogeny class, index] and back.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: ellconvertname(GEN name). Examples demonstrate roundtrip conversion.

rubrics_metrics.name: elldivpol: definition & roots
rubrics_metrics.description: n-division polynomial f_n for curve E in variable v. For n>=2, roots of f_n are X-coordinates of E[n].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specification of ψ_n-based formulas for odd/even n and explicit small-n polynomials (f1,f2,f3,f4 given). Syntax: elldivpol(GEN E, long n, long v = -1).

rubrics_metrics.name: elleisnum: Eisenstein series numeric evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute numerical value of Eisenstein series of even positive weight k at lattice w (as returned by ellperiods) or directly from ellinit curve.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When flag non-zero and k=4 or 6, returns elliptic invariants g2 or g3 so that y^2 = 4x^3 - g2 x - g3 is a Weierstrass equation. Syntax: elleisnum(GEN w, long k, long flag, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: elleta: quasi-periods
rubrics_metrics.description: Return quasi-periods [η1, η2] attached to lattice basis w = [ω1, ω2] or from ellinit E (E.eta).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: elleta(GEN w, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellformaldifferential: invariant differential series
rubrics_metrics.description: Return series f(t), g(t) (n terms) such that ω = f(t) dt and η = g(t) dt for canonical invariant differential ω and η = x(t)ω, where t = -x/y.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides explicit initial coefficients and seriesprecision parameter. Syntax: ellformaldifferential(GEN E, long precdl, long n = -1).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellformalexp / ellformallog: formal group inverse pair
rubrics_metrics.description: ellformalexp returns formal exponential Exp (inverse of elliptic logarithm). ellformallog returns formal elliptic logarithm series L such that dL = ω.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both return series with requested number of terms; Exp ◦ L = Id. Syntaxes: ellformalexp(GEN E, long precdl, long n = -1) and ellformallog(GEN E, long precdl, long n = -1). Examples show substitution verifying identity up to precision.

rubrics_metrics.name: ellformalpoint / ellformalw: formal-group coordinates & w-series
rubrics_metrics.description: ellformalpoint returns x(t), y(t) in formal group parameter t = -x/y at ∞; ellformalw returns formal w(t) = -1/y expansion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Return series with coefficients in Z[a1,a2,a3,a4,a6] up to seriesprecision. Syntax: ellformalpoint(GEN E, long precdl, long n = -1) and ellformalw(GEN E, long precdl, long n = -1).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellfromeqn: recover Weierstrass coefficients from genus-1 plane curve
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a genus-1 plane curve f(x,y)=0, return [a1,a2,a3,a4,a6] of Weierstrass equation for its Jacobian (Artin–Tate–Villegas formulae).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows conversion from twisted Edwards, general plane cubic, binary quartic/biquadratic. Examples include congruent-number construction. Syntax: ellfromeqn(GEN P).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellfromj: construct curve from j-invariant
rubrics_metrics.description: Return coefficients [a1,a2,a3,a4,a6] of a fixed elliptic curve with given j-invariant j.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: ellfromj(GEN j).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellgenerators: generators depending on domain and database
rubrics_metrics.description: If E/Q, return Z-basis of free part of Mordell-Weil group relying on elldata database (available only for small-conductor curves); if E/F_q return minimal set of generators for E(F_q).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires elldata for Q-case. Syntax: ellgenerators(GEN E).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellglobalred: global conductor & Tamagawa product
rubrics_metrics.description: For E over number field, compute arithmetic conductor N, (obsolete) v, global Tamagawa number c (product of local cp), factorization F of N, and vector L of local data (L[i]=elllocalred(E,F[i,1])).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For Q-domain certain fields differ (v replaced by 0). If starting with integral model v should be trivial. Syntax: ellglobalred(GEN E).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellgroup: group-structure computation & flags
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute structure of E(F_q) ≅ Z/d1 × Z/d2 with d2|d1. If E over Q, p must be given to compute reduction over F_p. Flag=0 returns [d1] or [d1,d2]; flag=1 returns [h, cyc, gen] with generators and curve cardinality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reduction may be singular; returns structure of non-singular points. Caution: not guaranteed that returned generator Q has order d2 without extra discrete-log computation; only ellweilpairing(E,P,Q,d1) guarantees order d2. Syntax: ellgroup0(GEN E, GEN p = NULL, long flag) or ellgroup(GEN E, GEN p) for flag=0.

rubrics_metrics.name: ellheegner: Heegner point construction & rank requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Return a non-torsion rational point via Heegner-point method for elliptic curves over Q assumed to have analytic rank 1.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complexity proportional to sqrt(conductor) * height of point; preferable for strong Weil curves. If curve has even analytic rank, function fails. Syntax: ellheegner(GEN E).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellheight / ellheightmatrix: Néron–Tate height normalization & matrix usage
rubrics_metrics.description: ellheight computes global Néron–Tate height h(P) (Cremona normalization). If Q provided computes bilinear form value. ellheightmatrix returns Gram matrix of given points for Néron–Tate height; determinant equals regulator (with normalization caveat).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: E need not be minimal but computation is faster when it is. Height normalization follows Cremona: matrix should be divided by 2 to match Silverman's normalization. Syntaxes: ellheight0(GEN E, GEN P, GEN Q = NULL, long prec) and ellheightmatrix(GEN E, GEN x, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellidentify: lookup & change-of-coordinates output
rubrics_metrics.description: Look up curve E (any model over Q) in elldata database; return [[N,M,G], C] where N is Cremona name, M minimal model, G basis of free part E(Q), and C coordinate-change suitable for ellchangecurve.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires elldata installed. Syntax: ellidentify(GEN E).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellinit: input forms, domain D semantics & singular-curve failure
rubrics_metrics.description: Initialize ell structure from either 5-vector [a1,a2,a3,a4,a6], short 2-vector [a4,a6], or Cremona string; optional D indicates domain (Q, F_p, F_q, Q_p with precision, C, number fields, prime ideals). If curve singular over D, returns empty vector [].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: D is indicative; coefficients checked for compatibility and may change D (error on inconsistent moduli). For p-adic inputs approximate model is lifted to Q. Resulting ell structure contains a1..a6, b2,b4,b6,b8,c4,c6,Δ,j and dynamic cached domain-specific data. Syntax: ellinit(GEN x, GEN D = NULL, long prec). Examples show behaviours over various domains and caching benefits for repeated calls.

rubrics_metrics.name: ellintegralmodel: integral model & returned change vector
rubrics_metrics.description: For E over a number field K, returns an integral model; if v provided sets v=[u,0,0,0] to corresponding change of variable (return identical to ellchangecurve(E,v)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: ellintegralmodel(GEN E, GEN *v = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellisdivisible: divisibility test & complexity
rubrics_metrics.description: Given E/K (number field) and P in E(K), return 1 if P = [n]R for some R in E(K) and set Q to such R; otherwise return 0. Integer n ≥ 0 may be given in ellxn form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Underlying algorithm complexity O(n^4); advisable to factor n first and use chain of prime-divisor checks. Function will factor n unless ellxn form used. Syntax: long ellisdivisible(GEN E, GEN P, GEN n, GEN *Q).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellisogeny: isogeny computation inputs & outputs
rubrics_metrics.description: Given curve E and finite subgroup G (generator point for cyclic G or polynomial for general case), return [a1..a6] invariants of E/G and (if only_image is zero) vector [f,g,h] of rational functions defining isogeny (x,y) -> (f(x)/h(x)^2, g(x,y)/h(x)^3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Polynomial option is more efficient when available. Syntax: ellisogeny(GEN E, GEN G, long only_image, long x = -1, long y = -1). Examples show obtaining quotient curve and isogeny rational functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: ellisogenyapply: apply/combine isogenies
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply isogeny f (result of ellisogeny) to point or to another compatible isogeny g: if g is a point P returns f(P); if g is isogeny returns composition f ◦ g.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to construct composite isogenies between curves. Syntax: ellisogenyapply(GEN f, GEN g).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellisomat: compute isogeny-class curves & degree matrix
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute representatives of isomorphism classes of curves Q-isogenous to E: returns [L,M] where L lists triples [Ei, fi, gi] (curves with isogenies) and M is matrix of degrees of isogenies between Ei and Ej. If flag=1 fi and gi omitted to save time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: First curve E1 is isomorphic to E. Syntax: ellisomat(GEN E, long fl). Examples show retrieving Cremona names and degree matrix.

rubrics_metrics.name: ellisoncurve: membership test with imprecise coefficients
rubrics_metrics.description: Returns 1 if point z is on curve E, 0 otherwise; attempts tolerant (imprecise) equality checks if E or z have imprecise coefficients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepts vector of points and returns corresponding vector; alternative int oncurve(GEN E, GEN z) does not accept vectors. Syntax: ellisoncurve(GEN E, GEN z).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellissupersingular: supersingularity test & domain rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Return 1 if E is supersingular at p (good reduction supersingular) and 0 otherwise. If E given over number field p must be supplied (prime or maximal ideal). If E given by j-invariant in finite field p may be omitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For E over Q returns 1 iff E has supersingular good reduction at p. Syntax: ellissupersingular(GEN E, GEN p = NULL) and helper elljissupersingular(GEN j) when j given.

rubrics_metrics.name: ellj: j-invariant domain & precision
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute elliptic j-invariant. Input must be complex with positive imaginary part or convertible to power series or p-adic with positive valuation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: jell(GEN x, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: elllocalred: Kodaira type and local Tamagawa output format
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute Kodaira type of local fiber of E at p. Returns [f, kod, v, c] where f is exponent of p in conductor, kod is coded Kodaira type, v = [u,r,s,t] are local coordinate changes (u=1 iff equation was minimal at p), c is local Tamagawa number cp.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Kodaira coding: 1 = I0 (good), 2,3,4 = II, III, IV; 4+ν with ν>0 denotes Iν; negative values denote starred types (I*, II*, ...). E must be ell structure with integral ai. Syntax: elllocalred(GEN E, GEN p).

rubrics_metrics.name: elllog: discrete logarithm limitations & preferred order format
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute discrete log of P base G on E/F_q returning smallest n with P=[n]G. Underlying discrete-log algorithm limitations apply. Optional o parameter represents order of G and preferred format is [N, factor(N)]. If o omitted assume G generates curve and P is multiple of G.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For large groups provide order information to speed computation. Syntax: elllog(GEN E, GEN P, GEN G, GEN o = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: elllseries: deprecated & performance note
rubrics_metrics.description: elllseries(E,s,{A=1}) is deprecated in favour of lfun(E,s); computes L-series value of E at complex s using O(N^{1/2}) algorithm where N is conductor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Optional cutoff parameter A for integral may be left omitted; result should be independent of A up to precision, allowing accuracy check. Use lfun(E,s) instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: ellminimalmodel: global minimal model existence & return semantics
rubrics_metrics.description: Determine whether E (ell structure over number field/K) admits a global minimal integral model; if so return it and set v=[u,r,s,t] to change of variables; else return Weierstrass class (non-principal).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires E defined over Q (global minimal model always exists) or number field given by bnf structure. Returned model has integral coefficients and is everywhere minimal with reductions on a1,a3 mod 2 and a2 mod 3; over Q further normalizations make v unique. Syntax: ellminimalmodel(GEN E, GEN *v = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellminimaltwist: pick twist minimizing discriminant or conductor
rubrics_metrics.description: For E/Q return discriminant D such that quadratic twist by D is minimal either by discriminant (flag=0) or by conductor (flag=1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also available convenience functions ellminimaltwist() and ellminimaltwistcond(). Examples show finding twist with minimal conductor. Syntax: ellminimaltwist0(GEN E, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellmoddegree: modular degree computation and error term
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute modular degree of elliptic curve e divided by square of Manin constant. Return [D, err] where D is rational and err is exponent of truncation error.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: ellmoddegree(GEN e, long bitprec).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellmodulareqn: modular equation retrieval & types
rubrics_metrics.description: Given prime N<500 return [P,t] where P(x,y) is modular equation of level N and t indicates type (0 canonical, 1 Atkin). Requires seadata package.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For canonical type f|W_N = N^s / f with s = 12/gcd(12,N-1); Atkin type satisfies f|W_N = f. Function used to compute classical modular polynomial Φ_N via elimination for certain N. Syntax: ellmodulareqn(long N, long x = -1, long y = -1).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellmul: scalar multiplication & CM special-case
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute [n]z on E where n ∈ Z, or complex quadratic integer when E has CM by n (otherwise error).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CM-case simple-minded algorithm assumes char 0 and small discriminant of quadratic order. Syntax: ellmul(GEN E, GEN z, GEN n).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellneg: point negation
rubrics_metrics.description: Return opposite (additive inverse) of point z on curve E.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: ellneg(GEN E, GEN z).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellnonsingularmultiple: least multiple with everywhere nonsingular reduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Given E/Q and rational P, returns [R,n] where n is least positive integer such that R=[n]P has good (non-singular) reduction at every prime in some minimal model.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: R is image in minimal model that is everywhere non-singular. Syntax: ellnonsingularmultiple(GEN E, GEN P). Examples show returned n can be >1.

rubrics_metrics.name: ellorder: order-of-point semantics and parameter o
rubrics_metrics.description: Return order of point z on E (finite-field or number-field). Return 0 if point has infinite order. Optional parameter o is mostly obsolete and represented as [ord, factor(ord)] when used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If E defined over Q and reduction singular, returns order of non-singular points. PARI caches curve cardinality so providing o offers no speedup in modern versions. Syntax: ellorder(GEN E, GEN z, GEN o = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellordinate: compute y-coordinates for given x
rubrics_metrics.description: Return 0,1, or 2-component vector containing y-coordinates of points of E having given x-coordinate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syntax: ellordinate(GEN E, GEN x, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: ellpadicL: p-adic L-function values & character parametrization
rubrics_metrics.description: Return value (or r-th derivative) of p-adic L-function of elliptic curve E/Q twisted by D on character χ_s of Z_p^* modulo p^n. Character s represented by pair (s1,s2) or integer using conventions; returns components depending on ordinary vs supersingular reduction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When E has good supersingular reduction L_p takes values in Q_p ⊗ H^1_dR(E/Q) and function returns components in basis (ω, F(ω)). When good ordinary reduction only projection to α-eigenspace returned (where α is unit eigenvalue for Frobenius). Normalization relations to complex L-value given: (1 - p^{-1} F)^{-2} L_p(E, χ_0) = (L(E,1)/Ω)·ω in supersingular case; (1-α^{-1})^{-2} L_{p,α}(E, χ_0) = L(E,1)/Ω in ordinary case. Syntax: ellpadicL(GEN E, GEN p, GEN n, GEN s = 0, GEN r = 0, GEN D = 1).
